## Libraries and data load

Put whatever libraries you use here.

```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

Load your data here

```{r}
#| label: import
#| message: false
sanitation <- read_csv("at_least_basic_sanitation_overall_access_percent.csv")
fertility  <- read_csv("children_per_woman_total_fertility.csv")
co2        <- read_csv("co2_pcap_cons.csv")
income     <- read_csv("ilevels4_wb.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
poverty    <- read_csv("number_of_people_in_poverty.csv")
democracy <- read_csv("democracy2020.csv")
```

Clean data

```{r}
#| label: drop-and-pivot
drop_and_pivot <- function(df, value_name) {
  df |>
    select(-any_of(as.character(2023:2100))) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(geo, name),
      names_to = "year",
      values_to = value_name
    ) |>
    mutate(year = as.integer(year))
}

sanitation_long <- drop_and_pivot(sanitation, "sanitation_access_pct")
fertility_long  <- drop_and_pivot(fertility, "children_per_woman")
co2_long        <- drop_and_pivot(co2, "co2_per_capita")
income_long     <- drop_and_pivot(income, "income_level")
poverty_long    <- drop_and_pivot(poverty, "people_in_poverty")
```

Join variables into one data frame

```{r}
#| label: join
combined <- list(
  sanitation_long, fertility_long, co2_long,
  income_long, poverty_long
) |>
  reduce(full_join, by = c("geo", "name", "year")) |>
  filter(year == 2020) |>
  arrange(geo, year)
combined <- combined |>
  inner_join(democracy, by = c("geo", "name")) |>
  na.omit()
```
